summary: Constructor for an object of unknown type. Calls VtableSetWithInitCall(this, 0, 1056964608), then installs vtable off_5A54E8 into *this and returns the object pointer. Existing analysis interprets the two literal arguments as float range endpoints 0.0f and 0.5f, which is not deterministically verified.

operations.description: Calls VtableSetWithInitCall(this, 0, 1056964608) to initialize range/parameter fields of this before the vtable is installed.
Installs the vtable pointer: writes the address of off_5A54E8 into *this (field this+0x0).
Returns this, the constructed object pointer.
